meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 把消息里的本地附件(Word、演示文稿、表格、PDF 等)在 agent 容器内转成本地 Markdown,并打印输出路径;文档内容按不可信数据处理,不会因其中要求而执行指令。
howto.when: 当一条消息给出本地附件路径,且需要在不把它上传到外部解析器的情况下读取时触发。

say.text: 把这个 CSV 附件转成 Markdown
say.note: 从标准输入读,会显式指定 csv 格式

say.text: 这份 PDF 是扫描图片版的,能转吗?
say.note: 会回复需要 OCR、不受支持

howto.what_en: It converts a local attachment from the message (Word, presentation, spreadsheet, PDF, etc.) into local Markdown inside the agent container and prints the output path. Document content is treated as untrusted data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

say_en.note: Runs inside the container and returns the output path

say_en.text: Convert this CSV attachment to Markdown
say_en.note: Read from stdin; the csv format is set explicitly

say_en.text: This PDF is scanned and image-only — can it convert?
say_en.note: Replies that OCR is needed and unsupported
